abstract: The differential diagnosis between solid teratomas and malignant mixed Müllerian tumors (MMTs) can be difficult, because both tumours have an epithelial as well as a mesenchymal component. Sometimes an MMT is incorrectly diagnosed as a solid teratoma. This has prognostic and therapeutic consequences, because MMTs have a worse prognosis. In this study 20 solid ovarian teratomas and 15 MMTs of the ovary have been compared according to their clinical, histomorphological, and immunocytochemical characteristics. Teratomas occur in the younger age group and are characterized by the presence of argyrophil cells which are immunoreactive to a wide range of neurohormonal peptides and are in addition characterized by the presence of GFAP immunoreactive tissues (glial fibrillar acidic protein). MMTs occur in the older age group and are characterized by the presence of sarcomatous elements and by the absence of an organoid arrangement, neuroectoderm, skin, argyrophilia, and immunoreactivity to GFAP and neurofilament.
abstract_ja: 鑑別診断において、充実性奇形腫と悪性混合ミュラー管腫瘍（MMT）は、いずれも上皮成分と間葉成分を持つため困難な場合があります。MMTが誤って充実性奇形腫と診断されることがあり、MMTは予後が不良であるため、予後および治療に影響を及ぼします。本研究では、卵巣の充実性奇形腫20例と卵巣のMMT15例について、臨床的、組織形態学的、免疫細胞化学的特徴を比較しました。奇形腫は若年層に多く、多様な神経ホルモンペプチドに免疫反応性を示す銀親和性細胞を特徴とし、GFAP（グリア線維性酸性タンパク質）陽性組織を含みます。MMTは高齢層に多く、肉腫様成分を特徴とし、器官様配列、神経外胚葉、皮膚、銀親和性、GFAPおよびニューロフィラメントへの免疫反応性を欠いています。
